calls.title: setting up GB SSO
calls.summary: During the meeting, the team discussed the setup of Single Sign-On (SSO) for Growth Book, deciding on a cloud-hosted solution for simplified deployment. Brian Schultz confirmed the shift from self-hosting, while Jake Heier and Chris Sanders noted that no license key is necessary for the cloud version. Gregory Craig created an Azure app registration for SSO, emphasizing the importance of matching the redirect URI with the Growth Book cloud domain. There were challenges with Brian's admin access, which is essential for configuration, prompting a regroup to identify the right admin. The team also explored user provisioning options and shared documentation to facilitate the onboarding process, highlighting the need for clear communication as they move forward with the SSO implementation.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, Single Sign-On, OpenID Connect, Azure, Cloud Deployment, User Provisioning
